b: I tried everything and I still failed. I'm currently sweating in the same clothes I've been wearing for a week. I had a dream that my life would turn around. And that I would be able to prove my bullies wrong. But no. I'm in the worst position in my life. And I won't be doing well anytime soon. I was sleeping on a bench until a group of people woke me up. I just cried and wanted to forget this reality. I never thought I'd be like this at all. I can't keep doing this anymore. I don't even get hungry any more. I just let myself starve and go about my day. And I just dream. And all of those dreams are killed and foolish in my head. I'm young, but I feel so old, worn out, and disconnected from the world. I'm trying, I promise. But nothing is happening for me. Homelessness might've claimed my life. And I have no friends to fight it with. I'm so tired and always wondering when it's going to be my time. I'm surviving and not living. It's tearing me apart.
